observations: Photo 0: Close-up of a DAF engine control/valve cover area stamped “DAF 24 VALVE”; surrounding hoses, wiring, and pulleys visible.
Photo 1: Large engine bay laid out with many components; a turbo/air intake area and a large fan/duct housing visible; engine appears partially disassembled.
Photo 2: Wider view of the engine assembly on the ground; two DAF-branded valve covers visible; multiple intake/exhaust pipes and hoses; engine bay covered with a cloth sheet in the background.
